memory_update.text: ULS is the clean public reference company for energy testing, inspection, certification, grid-code compliance, battery safety, power-distribution equipment, and renewable project certification/advisory.

The investable node currently maps better to TIC/testing/certification, grid-edge analytics, geospatial inspection, and utility planning software than to broad enterprise supply-chain software.

node: Critical energy supplier-risk management, resilience, testing, certification, and procurement intelligence
summary: Layer 1B expands the direct and second-order public-company map for the supplier-risk, resilience, testing, certification, and procurement-intelligence node. The cleanest direct public exposure is testing/inspection/certification and utility/grid analytics rather than generic enterprise software. The two-lane list uses UL Solutions as the reference TIC leader, then focuses the discovery lane on TIC Solutions, Willdan, and Itron as smaller or more niche public companies tied to utility resilience, grid planning, asset integrity, inspections, certification, and analytics. Claims are deliberately conservative because this node is still a speculative_shadow lane and requires later verification of energy-specific revenue concentration, recurring software mix, utility customer penetration, and whether supplier-risk complexity translates into measurable orders or margins.
